learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to use large numbers to plan exciting journeys, measure long distances, and figure out how much time it takes to travel to amazing new places!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we travel to far-off places, we use very large numbers on maps. If a beautiful city is 1,250 kilometers away, we use our math skills to read and understand this big number to plan our trip perfectly!
Distance tells us exactly how far apart two places are. We usually measure long journeys between cities in kilometers (km) and shorter walks around our neighborhood in meters (m).
Speed is a super cool math trick that tells us how fast a vehicle is moving. For example, if a train travels 60 kilometers in just one hour, we say its speed is 60 kilometers per hour!
Here is the best part of being a math traveller! If we know the total distance of our trip and the speed of our car or train, we can easily calculate how many hours the journey will take.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Dream Vacation Planner
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents the distance in kilometers to your favorite holiday spot. If your family car drives at a steady speed of 50 kilometers per hour, try to guess how many hours it will take to get there!

quick_recap: ⭐ Distance is how far away a place is, usually measured in kilometers (km) for long travel.
⭐ Speed shows us how fast we are going on our journey.
⭐ Using large numbers helps us plan our trips and become super smart travellers!
